description: This file contains utility functions related to configuring and retrieving install schemes for Python packages using distutils and pip internals. It focuses on managing installation paths, schemes, and handling virtual environments.

classes.name: Scheme
classes.description: A data class representing different scheme paths for package installation.

methods.description: Returns a dictionary of installation scheme paths based on input parameters, utilizing distutils Distribution.

methods.name: str get_bin_prefix()

methods.description: Returns the path to the platform-specific library directory.
